framework: AWS Security Best Practices + PCI-DSS v4.0 (guidance mapping)
description: Amazon ECR security checks for access control, immutability, scanning, encryption, and lifecycle hygiene

items.title: Repositories must not allow public access via wildcard principals
items.description: A repository policy that allows Principal '*' (or AWS '*') can expose container images publicly, enabling unauthorized pulls and supply-chain compromise.
items.remediation: Remove wildcard principals from repository policies. Use least-privilege principals (specific IAM roles/users/accounts) and conditions. Validate with: aws ecr get-repository-policy --repository-name <name>.

pci_dss.reason: Access to system components and data must be restricted by default. Public principals violate least privilege.

items.title: Image tags should be immutable
items.description: Mutable tags allow overwriting images (e.g., 'latest'), increasing risk of untracked changes and supply-chain abuse.
items.remediation: Enable IMMUTABLE tags: aws ecr put-image-tag-mutability --repository-name <name> --image-tag-mutability IMMUTABLE.

pci_dss.reason: Change control requires integrity and traceability of deployed components. Immutable tags support controlled, auditable changes.

items.title: Image scanning on push should be enabled
items.description: Scan-on-push enables continuous vulnerability discovery at publish time, reducing exposure to known vulnerable images.
items.remediation: Enable scan on push per repo: aws ecr put-image-scanning-configuration --repository-name <name> --image-scanning-configuration scanOnPush=true. Consider enabling registry scanning configuration for consistent coverage.

pci_dss.reason: Vulnerability management is required for system components. Scanning supports identification of vulnerabilities in container images.

items.title: Registry scanning configuration should be defined
items.description: A defined registry scanning configuration (rules and scan type) improves consistency and prevents coverage gaps.
items.remediation: Define a registry scanning configuration with required scan type/rules. Validate with: aws ecr describe-registry-scanning-configuration.

pci_dss.reason: A formal vulnerability identification process improves coverage and repeatability.

items.title: Repositories should use KMS customer-managed keys when required
items.description: Customer-managed KMS keys provide stronger governance (policy controls, rotation, auditability) than default encryption.
items.remediation: Create/choose a CMK and configure repository encryption where applicable. For existing repos, migrate policy and controls around key usage; ensure IAM key permissions follow least privilege.

pci_dss.reason: Cryptographic mechanisms must be protected; CMKs provide finer control over key access and governance.

items.title: Lifecycle policies should be configured to expire unused images
items.description: Without lifecycle policies, old/untagged images can accumulate, increasing attack surface and operational risk.
items.remediation: Define lifecycle policies to expire untagged images and old versions. Validate with: aws ecr get-lifecycle-policy --repository-name <name>.

pci_dss.reason: Unused components increase risk. Lifecycle hygiene supports reducing unnecessary artifacts.

items.title: Cross-account repository access should be explicitly reviewed
items.description: Cross-account principals in repository policies can unintentionally expose images or enable supply-chain compromise if not tightly controlled.
items.remediation: Restrict repository policies to required accounts/roles only, add conditions (e.g., aws:PrincipalArn), and consider service control policies. Review principals regularly.

pci_dss.reason: Least privilege requires limiting access to only necessary principals, including external accounts.

items.title: Registry replication configuration should be evaluated for resiliency
items.description: Replication can improve availability and support regional resiliency depending on business needs.
items.remediation: If required, configure ECR replication to secondary regions/accounts. Validate with: aws ecr describe-registry.

items.title: Repository policies should prefer explicit principals over broad patterns
items.description: Broad principals or overly permissive actions (ecr:*) increase blast radius. Policies should use explicit principals and actions.
items.remediation: Review repository policies and restrict Actions to only required (e.g., ecr:BatchGetImage, ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer). Avoid ecr:* unless justified.

pci_dss.reason: Least privilege requires limiting actions to the minimum required.

items.title: ECR evidence should include registry-level settings
items.description: If registry-level evidence is missing due to permissions, findings that depend on it should be treated as unverifiable.
items.remediation: Ensure the audit role has permissions for: ecr:DescribeRegistry, ecr:DescribeRegistryScanningConfiguration, ecr:GetRegistryPolicy.

notes: This checklist is guidance-oriented; PCI DSS mappings are indicative and may require adaptation based on environment scope and CDE definition.
